verses.text: 434. Jesus‘ Resurrection glorifies the name of the Saviour God, for from that time on it is the name of Jesus that fully manifests the supreme power of the “name which is above every name”. (Phil 2:9-10; cf. Jn 12:28.) The evil spirits fear his name; in his name his disciples perform miracles, for the Father grants all they ask in this name. (Cf. Acts 16:16-18; 19:13-16; Mk 16:17; Jn 15:16.)
